items.title: New section skinning.md: per-addon skin via the LibKa0s Skin facade, Appearance tab, EllesmereUI provider carve-out, anti-pattern with leg-2 commencement; library-stack and options-ui ripple
items.issue_refs: OWNER_SCOPE R1-R8; 03_SPEC §1, §3, §4, §5, §7; inputs/LIBKA0S_INTERNALS.md §1 item 8 (library-stack.md:92 module table, :128 major count)
items.spec:
Write a new standards section file named skinning (follow the existing section file shape, numbering §1.., index entry in STANDARDS.md Sections list placed sensibly, e.g. after frame-layering). Content (normative, MUST/SHOULD): (1) every visual element of an addon that has adopted skins paints through the LibKa0s Skin facade (LibKa0s-Skin-1.0) with the addon folder name as owner, registered at file load; (2) the skin choice is per addon, stored in the profile as appearance.source and appearance.skin (defaults "ka0s"/"ka0s"); (3) the Appearance tab on the General page, after Interface and before Keybindings, drawn by O.AppearanceTab; (4) the shipped skins list (nine keys) and that Ka0s Default reproduces the pre-skin look; (5) the EllesmereUI provider: gate conditions, the named read-only call-time read of EllesmereUIDB confined to LibKa0s/SkinEUI.lua as an explicit carve-out of library-stack-§6 / anti-pattern #29, reload rule eui->ka0s; (6) HUD style settings resolve through the FROM_SKIN sentinel, and on adoption an addon resets its saved HUD style values to the sentinel once (owner ruling R3); (7) never skin Blizzard shared frames (SettingsPanel, StaticPopup, GameTooltip, ColorPickerFrame), never leak through AceGUI pools, taint rules; (8) a new anti-pattern "hard-coded chrome color/font in an addon that has adopted skins", with a COMMENCEMENT note: binding for an addon once it adopts skins (LootHistory from this run; the other addons at their leg-2 rollout), so unconverted addons are not findings. Ripple: library-stack.md module table gains LibKa0s-Skin-1.0 and the "N of M majors floor on Core" count; options-ui General-tab order gains Appearance; anti-pattern list numbering; executive summary / context pack / AUDIT.md / NEW_ADDON*.md only where the repo's ripple rules say a new section must appear. Changelog entry lines.

PLAN-REVIEW RESOLUTION: (1) Rescope every normative look value to 'the Ka0s Default skin' in the same commit: standalone-windows 'The Ka0s window edge' (:15-28) gets 'an addon that has adopted skins draws edge/title/divider/close tints from its owner's skin through the LibKa0s Skin facade and MUST NOT diverge from that skin; an addon that has not adopted keeps these exact values'. Do the same for the close-mark sentence (:30), the TestStrip color (:46: amber/cyan stay the library's meaning colors, and a skin changes only legibility via strip.*), the options-ui header/divider/heading fonts (:136, :196-197, :209, :262) and the debug-logging console colors (:56: keep the tag/timestamp/content distinction). The skinning section lists each rescoped rule by filename-§N, says facade overlays follow frame-layering-§3, and says the AceGUI paint follows options-ui-§19, including the host's duty to paint widgets it acquires itself via Skin:PaintAce and the OnRelease chain helper. (2) Amend library-stack-§6 itself (:68) with one named exception: LibKa0s-Skin-1.0's EllesmereUI provider, LibKa0s/SkinEUI.lua only, MAY read EllesmereUIDB.thirdPartySkinsOff and thirdPartySkinAddons[<owner>], read-only, at call time, nil-guarded and never written. Amend anti-pattern #29 (anti-patterns.md:35) to end '... except library-stack-§6's skinning exception'. skinning.md cites §6 rather than restating it, and PGFE's own EUIBridge read stays its register row. (3) Update library-stack-§8 (:389-416) with the OFL faces and their per-entry masks, the border/background catalogs and the rounded nine-slice textures with their tools/ generator, and keep the host-folder MUST. (4) Move all library-stack-§7 module-table and count work to the new WS-02. (5) Tab position, in standard terms: 'Appearance is a General-page tab immediately before Keybindings, or last where there is no Keybindings tab; on RenderTabbedSchema its before is the Keybindings key', with a note on the options-ui-§13 eight-tab budget. Replace 'after Interface' everywhere. (6) Storage: the two choice values are per profile, written only through the addon's single write seam (options-ui-§1). The exact path is the addon's own convention. (7) An adopted addon lists EllesmereUI in ## OptionalDeps (library-stack-§6(b)). Its Options degradation stub answers AppearanceTab and AppearanceRows from its first re-vendor of LibKa0s v1.78.0 (options-ui-§20 wording). (8) Define adoption mechanically as 'the addon's own code calls Skin:RegisterOwner(<its folder>)'. The commencement is that adoption, naming no addon (STANDARDS.md:44). (9) The ripple is mandatory (v2.88.0 WS-06 precedent, 6ca3173): an AUDIT.md 'Check skinning' step (literal grep outside the seam, tab position, stored keys, OptionalDeps, stub members; 'not adopted, not a finding'); NEW_ADDON_CONTEXT.md and NEW_ADDON.md say a new addon MAY adopt and is not required to until leg 2, with a definition-of-done line; one EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY pattern line; open-evolutions entries (the leg-1 token splits, the WoW Forever client LibKa0s#44, the leg-2 HUD reset); docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:47/:94 28 -> 29; the new anti-pattern takes #107 and the index blurb reads (#1–#107). One changelog ruling for the rescope.

items.title: Kit revision 43: opt-in paint recorder mock (colors, fonts, textures, backdrop, regions, NineSlice) for headless skin tests
items.spec:
Add an opt-in sibling mock file in testkit/ (e.g. testkit/mock_paint.lua; do not grow mock_base.lua, which is at 1464 lines) that, when enabled by a suite, makes frames/textures/fontstrings record paint calls: SetColorTexture, SetVertexColor, SetGradient, SetTexture, SetAtlas (already recorded: keep compatible), SetTexCoord, SetAlpha/GetAlpha, Show/Hide/IsShown on regions, SetTextColor/GetTextColor, SetFont/GetFont, SetFontObject, SetShadowOffset/SetShadowColor, SetBackdrop/SetBackdropColor/SetBackdropBorderColor, SetDesaturated; CreateTexture/CreateFontString return distinct region objects owned by the frame (not the frame itself) when the recorder is on; GetRegions/GetChildren return them; NineSlice child stub with the standard piece keys; HookScript chaining preserved. Keep default (recorder off) behavior byte-for-byte what consumers rely on today. Bump Kit.VERSION to 43, write docs/api/testkit/version-43-docs.md (mark 42 superseded per convention), re-copy testkit/ to tests/_kit/ so test_kitsync passes, CHANGELOG lines. Tests for the recorder itself.

PLAN-REVIEW RESOLUTION (run-level versioning ruling, binding on LK-01..LK-11 and LK-90; repeat-cited in each): (1) each item bumps once the minor of every payload file it changes, and its commit leaves the gate green (test_versioning needs a doc and members manifest at the live key on every run). (2) An unreleased major or key has exactly ONE in-flight doc: `git mv` docs/api/<Major>/version-<old-key>-docs.md and members-<old-key>.json to the new key, regenerate with `lua tools/gen-api-members.lua`, and update only the 'Superseded by' cell of the last RELEASED (v1.77.0) doc. Never create a superseded doc for a key that never shipped (v1.77.0 precedent: `git log v1.76.0..v1.77.0 -- docs/api/Options`). (3) A new payload file goes into tests/majors.lua (files + paired), LibKa0s.xml and the in-flight doc in the same commit. (4) The first item that moves a minor opens '## v1.78.0 — unreleased' in CHANGELOG.md, and every item names its new minors there as they land. (5) Kit revision 43 is opened once, here. A later testkit change in this run (for example LK-08) extends revision 43's doc and re-copies tests/_kit with no bump to 44. LK-01 specifics: testkit/mock_base.lua is 1464 lines with a band re-check at 1490 or +30 lines, so mock_base gains only the opt-in load line(s). The recorder lives wholly in testkit/mock_paint.lua, patches M.CreateFrame the way mock_layers.lua does, is off by default, and exposes a restore so a suite that enables it can switch it off in a finally-style block. Add to VERIFY: `tests/_kit/run-automated-tests.sh --suite complexity --no-bundle` reports 0 functions above CCN 15, run through /home/tushar/.claude/dev-copilot/bin/ka0s-bounded and never raw lizard.

items.title: Media: ship OFL fonts (Barlow Regular+SemiBold, Cinzel SemiBold, Atkinson Hyperlegible Regular+Bold) with licenses, per-font locale masks, LSM border/background catalogs, Glass rounded nine-slice textures
items.issue_refs: OWNER_SCOPE R7; 03_SPEC §2 fonts/textures; inputs/LIBKA0S_INTERNALS.md; inputs/ACEGUI_AND_ENGINE_RESEARCH.md (§4 media; research §5, §6)
items.spec:
Download static TTFs from the official upstream sources (google/fonts GitHub ofl/ directories or the font projects' release pages); if only a variable font is available (Cinzel), produce a static SemiBold instance with fontTools (python3 -m fontTools.varLib.instancer) and note that in the license/readme. Ship each with its OFL.txt beside it under the payload media fonts folder (follow Media.lua's existing font layout and tests/test_media.lua license gate). Register with LibSharedMedia as "Ka0s Barlow", "Ka0s Barlow SemiBold", "Ka0s Cinzel", "Ka0s Atkinson", "Ka0s Atkinson Bold", with a per-font locale mask (Western only for these; keep JetBrains Mono's existing mask). Paths resolve from the winning LibKa0s copy's folder. Add LSM "border" and "background" catalog registration for shipped textures: generate white rounded-corner nine-slice TGA(s) for Glass (radius 8, 32x32 or similar, power-of-two, uncompressed TGA with alpha) with a small python script kept in tools/ (document it), plus register the in-client keys the skins will use (e.g. Blizzard Dialog border/background) only if LSM does not already. Media minor bump; prune-icons.lua must not touch the new folders (verify). Tests: registration, masks, files exist, licenses present. README credits/licenses section and DEPENDENCIES.md (assets) updated.

PLAN-REVIEW RESOLUTION: delete the sentence 'Paths resolve from the winning LibKa0s copy's folder'. It contradicts LibKa0s/Media.lua:14-31 ('Lua gives a file no way to ask where it is') and library-stack-§8 (MUST: every path is built from the host's own folder name). Add the five faces to lib.FONTS with a per-entry langmask field: Western only for Barlow, Cinzel and Atkinson, while JetBrains Mono keeps today's western+ruRU mask (Media.lua:334-339 is one global mask now, so this becomes per entry). Add the BORDERS/BACKGROUNDS catalogs and the Glass nine-slice textures. Register all of them through the existing M.RegisterLSM(addonName) loop (Media.lua:372-404), which every consumer already calls from core/MediaSetup.lua. Skins name fonts and textures by LSM key ('Ka0s Barlow'), the engine resolves them with LSM:Fetch at paint time, and it falls back to the template font or STANDARD_TEXT_FONT when the key is not valid for the client locale. The Skin engine never builds a file path. Record in the v1.78.0 CHANGELOG block that, in leg 1, the new LSM keys resolve to LootHistory's folder because LSM keeps the first registration and LootHistory is the first v1.78.0 runner to call RegisterLSM. Leg 2's re-vendor ships the files to every consumer. Tests: per-font masks, file and OFL presence, and that RegisterLSM('X') registers 'Ka0s Barlow' under Interface\AddOns\X\libs\LibKa0s\media\fonts\... Follow the LK-01 versioning ruling; add the complexity-suite VERIFY line.
verify: lua tools/prune-icons.lua dry behavior leaves fonts/textures intact (test or documented manual check)

items.title: New major LibKa0s-Skin-1.0: owner registry, choice, resolve, per-owner frame registry and live repaint, OnLooksChanged, FROM_SKIN sentinel helpers; SkinDefs.lua with the nine skins (Ka0s Default = today's constants)
items.issue_refs: OWNER_SCOPE R1-R4, R7; 03_SPEC §2, §3; inputs/LIBKA0S_INTERNALS.md; inputs/ACEGUI_AND_ENGINE_RESEARCH.md; token source inputs/mockup-tokens.dc.html (BASE/SKINS) and plan-data/mockups/skins-mockup.html
items.spec:
Implement 03_SPEC §2 (token schema) and §3 (engine, minus primitives which are LK-04, minus EUI which is LK-05). Files: LibKa0s/Skin.lua (primary: NewLibrary("LibKa0s-Skin-1.0", 1), Core floor, MODULES, owner registry lib.owners, RegisterOwner/For/SetChoice/GetChoice/Resolve/Token/Color/OnLooksChanged scoped per owner, weak frame registry lib.painted + lib.byOwner, repaint loop, FROM_SKIN = "@skin", ResetToSkin(profile, keys)), LibKa0s/SkinDefs.lua (secondary paired on the shell's minor: RegisterSkin + the nine skins: ka0s, obsidian, azeroth, glass, contrast, ember, wow, midnight, forever, each with label, desc, 4 swatches, tokens). Ka0s Default token values MUST equal today's constants (inputs/LIBKA0S_INTERNALS.md §2 table and inputs/LOOTHISTORY_SURFACES.md §3); where two sites draw one role in different colors keep two tokens. Other skins translate the mockup tokens (CSS) into the schema faithfully; WoW Forever follows OWNER_SCOPE R4 (warm charcoal bg, black title bar with CENTER white title, tan accent ~#C9A07A, gold headings ~#F2B33D, thin borders, Barlow), WoW Default the vanilla look (Blizzard dialog border/background textures, red buttons with gold text), WoW Midnight night-blue/gold/violet. Fonts per 03_SPEC §2. LibKa0s.xml rows, tests/majors.lua row with paired entries, docs/api/Skin/version-<key>-docs.md (members, adopting it, token schema reference table listing every token and its Ka0s Default value), docs/api/README row, README module table, docs/releasing.md lists. Tests: every skin resolves every schema token; Ka0s Default equals the legacy constants (pin against lib.SKIN and the file-local tables); per-owner isolation (owner A switching never repaints B's frames); repaint calls each recorded frame once; FROM_SKIN resolve and ResetToSkin. CCN <= 15, files <= 1500 lines.

PLAN-REVIEW RESOLUTION: LK-03 is now the ENGINE plus Ka0s Default only. The other eight skin tables, the completeness test and the token reference move to the new LK-11. (1) Facade: Skin:For(owner) returns lib.facades[owner], one table per owner that is kept across minors. Each entry is a late-bound trampoline, `S.Button = function(...) return lib.prim.Button(owner, ...) end`, and a newer minor re-fills lib.prim on load. Never capture a primitive in a facade closure. Keep all state as `lib.x = lib.x or {}`. Test: swap lib.prim.Button for a spy, call S.Button, and the spy is hit. (2) Skin:IsOwner(name) is true only after RegisterOwner. Unregistered names take today's code path verbatim (this binds LK-06/07/08). (3) SetChoice is idempotent: it does nothing when (source, skin) equals GetChoice. It resolves first, then fires S.OnLooksChanged. It sets one pending-reload flag per owner on an eui->other transition and returns it, so callers raise the reload popup at most once. (4) Ka0s Default fidelity: Ka0s Default font tokens are nil, meaning 'leave the FontString's font object alone'. A primitive calls SetFont/SetFontObject only for a non-nil token, records the prior object and restores it on a switch back. Leg-1 geometry is skin-invariant: title.height, scroll.width and the window content insets equal Ka0s Default in every skin (LK-11 asserts this), and border or nine-slice art is drawn outset or inside a fixed inset, so content anchors never move. (5) Schema additions: <ctl>.borderSize and <ctl>.borderStyle ('flat'|'bevelOut'|'bevelIn'|'nine:<key>') for btn, btnPrimary, input, check, tab, nav, drawer, popup and menu; win.bgTop/bgBottom and title.bgTop/bgBottom (vertical gradient, nil = flat); input/tab/check/scroll/popup .radius; gtip.title/gtip.body/gtip.muted for lines on Blizzard's GameTooltip (Ka0s Default 1,.82,0 / .9 / .5); keep a separate text.headingAlt for LootHistory's .91,.77,.42 gold. (6) Ka0s Default values come only from today's constants (inputs/LIBKA0S_INTERNALS.md §2, LOOTHISTORY_SURFACES.md §3), never from the mockup's BASE CSS. (7) The new-major ripple, which no gate catches: the LibKa0s CLAUDE.md Documentation-map docs/api parenthetical (add Skin), README.md:13 and :113 major counts and the module table, docs/releasing.md:28/:57 (constant list, 'seventeen') and :268 (file count), and the CHANGELOG block's major and file counts. Follow the LK-01 versioning ruling; add the complexity-suite VERIFY line.

items.title: SkinDefs: the eight non-default skins, completeness and invariance tests, token reference, Blizzard-art choices
items.spec: Split out of LK-03, so LK-03 is the engine plus Ka0s Default only. Add Obsidian, Azeroth, Glass, High Contrast, Ember, WoW Default, WoW Midnight and WoW Forever to SkinDefs, translated from inputs/mockup-tokens.dc.html with this key map: classic -> ka0s (but Ka0s Default stays LK-03's constants, never the mockup's BASE), wowdefault -> wow, and every other key unchanged. The mockup's 'eui' entry is only the EllesmereUI preview and is never registered. A key a mockup skin omits inherits from Ka0s Default's Lua values. Fill the LK-03 schema additions (per-control borderSize/borderStyle, win/title gradients, per-control radii, gtip.*). High Contrast uses 2px control borders. Glass uses radius 8 nine-slice. WoW Default: the BACKDROP_DIALOG_32_32 edge (UI-DialogBox-Border) over UI-DialogBox-Background-Dark; buttons as a red gradient with a 2px bevelOut gold #a07c2c edge; tabs UI-OptionsFrame-ActiveTab/InActiveTab; scroll thumb UI-ScrollBar-Knob; checkbox UI-CheckBox-Up/Check. WoW Midnight: flat WHITE8x8 with a 2px #b08a3e border plus gradient tokens, no Blizzard art. WoW Forever: warm charcoal, black title bars with centered white titles, a tan accent, gold headings, thin borders (R4). Record these choices in docs/api/Skin, which closes 03_SPEC §9's open texture point. Tests (new suite): every skin defines every schema token or inherits it; geometry tokens (title.height, scroll.width, content insets) equal Ka0s Default in all nine; each skin's gtip.* contrast against a dark (.05,.05,.08) background is legible; each skin's text tokens contrast against its own win.bg. Follow the LK-01 versioning ruling. VERIFY: lua tests/run.lua 0 failed; luacheck . 0/0; complexity suite 0 above CCN 15; files <= 1500 lines.

items.title: Ka0s primitives (SkinPaint): the EllesmereUI-compatible vocabulary plus Ka0s extras, idempotent, repaintable, recorded per owner
items.issue_refs: 03_SPEC §3 Facade; inputs/LIBKA0S_INTERNALS.md; inputs/ACEGUI_AND_ENGINE_RESEARCH.md (research §2 technique, §4 live repaint, §5 textures)
items.spec:
Implement the facade primitives for source "ka0s" in one or more secondaries paired on the Skin shell (e.g. LibKa0s/SkinPaint.lua, SkinPaintControls.lua) so S = Skin:For(owner) exposes: Shell(frame, opts{noBorder,noTopBar,bottomBar}), Panel(frame, opts{inset,noBorder,noBg}), Inset, FadeRegions, FadeNineSlice, Button(btn, keepKeys | opts{primary}), WhiteButtonLabel, StateButtonLabel, EditBox(eb, opts{padInput,noBorder}), Checkbox(cb, opts{stockCheck,borderInset,hover}), Dropdown, ScrollBar, Tab, SetTabSelection, CloseButton, PageButton, SquareIcon, SortHeaderBar, Font(fs, r,g,b), White, ApplyBarFill, GetAccentColor, GetPanelColor, GetFont, OnLooksChanged, IsEnabled, GetStyle ("ka0s:<key>"), apiVersion = 3, and extras TitleBar, Divider, Footer, Card, Slider, NavItem, Drawer, ListRow(row, state), MenuFrame, Tooltip (library-owned frames), Strip, Cover, Text(fs, role), Token, Color, ChartStyle, BarStyle, IconBorder, GlowColor. Technique: stock art faded by alpha (prior values recorded), Ka0s regions created once per frame and kept in the weak record, never Hide/SetParent/SetScript on Blizzard frames, SetBackdrop only on frames the library or the owner created with BackdropTemplate, borders as 1px edge textures or nine-slice per the token, gradients via SetGradient, fonts via a per-owner FontObject then SetFont (12.0.7 shadow rule). Repaint re-applies colors/fonts/textures from the new skin on the recorded regions. Tests with the LK-01 recorder: each primitive paints from tokens, idempotent second call, repaint changes the recorded regions to the new skin, Ka0s Default output for Shell equals what Core.ApplySkin paints today.

PLAN-REVIEW RESOLUTION: (1) Every Ka0s overlay and extra (Divider, TitleBar fill, Footer, Card, ListRow, Strip, borders) lives on a per-record child holder frame (CreateFrame('Frame', nil, frame), SetAllPoints, level +1), never as a direct texture region of a frame that may reach an EUI primitive. EllesmereUI's FadeRegions/Restrip fade every direct region (EllesmereUIBlizzardSkin_WindowEngine.lua:126-140, :199-217). (2) For a registered owner on ka0s, the paint-call trace of each primitive must be identical to today's code, in calls, order, arity and objects. Prove it with the LK-01 recorder per factory. Shell is already pinned against Core.ApplySkin; extend this to every primitive LK-06/07/09 route. (3) In docs/api/Skin, document for each primitive which Media icon keys it draws, and prefer WHITE8x8 or in-client art so that no new icon set is needed. (4) Implement WoW Default/Midnight art per the LK-11 choices. Follow the LK-01 versioning ruling; add the complexity-suite VERIFY line (the painters are the branchiest code in the run, so keep each function at CCN 15 or below).

items.title: EllesmereUI provider (SkinEUI): per-owner RegisterSkin, gate, pass-through + getter-based extras, fail-closed, reload rule; deviation register row
items.issue_refs: OWNER_SCOPE brief; 03_SPEC §5; ../PremadeGroupsFilterExtension/core/EUIBridge.lua, modules/EUISkin.lua, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "EllesmereUI seams", its tests' EUI fake (m.installEUI); EllesmereUI SKINNING_API.md (read via "/mnt/g/Games/Blizzard/World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/AddOns/EllesmereUI/SKINNING_API.md"; describe, never copy code)
items.spec:
Implement 03_SPEC §5 in LibKa0s/SkinEUI.lua (secondary on the Skin shell). RegisterOwner calls EllesmereUI.RegisterSkin(owner, cb) when present; cb stores the facade per owner and paints only while that owner's source is "eui" and the gate holds; shape check before any paint (refuse + latch + one log line if a needed primitive is missing); pcall the paint, fail closed. Skin:GetEUIStatus(owner) returns the three conditions with ok/label/hint for the Appearance tab. Switching ka0s->eui live: hide Ka0s overlays of the owner's recorded frames then run the EUI primitives; eui->ka0s: set pending-reload and fire a reload request callback (the tab shows the popup). Ka0s extras under eui paint from S.GetAccentColor/GetPanelColor/GetFont and follow S.OnLooksChanged. Add the documented-deviation row to LibKa0s CLAUDE.md register (library-stack-§6 / anti-pattern #29: read-only, call-time, nil-guarded reads of EllesmereUIDB.thirdPartySkinsOff and .thirdPartySkinAddons[owner], confined to SkinEUI.lua; Decided 2026-10-25 per the owner's brief and PGFE's 2026-10-09 ratification; re-check trigger: EllesmereUI publishes a query API that works before dispatch, or the read spreads to another file). Tests with a headless EllesmereUI fake (testkit or test-local), modeled on PGFE's: gate permutations, dispatch before/after login, per-owner isolation, shape refusal, fallback to Ka0s skin when gate fails.

PLAN-REVIEW RESOLUTION (now depends on WS-01): (1) Add NO LibKa0s register row for the EllesmereUIDB read. WS-01 amends library-stack-§6 with a named exception, so the read is compliant. Instead, cite that exception in SkinEUI.lua's header and in the Skin API doc. Add a payload grep test proving that 'EllesmereUIDB' appears only in LibKa0s/SkinEUI.lua. The register's 'Eight rows.' paragraph stays as it is. (2) The callback passed to EllesmereUI.RegisterSkin is a trampoline, `function(S) LibStub('LibKa0s-Skin-1.0'):__OnEUIFacade(owner, S) end`, and the facade is stored in lib.euiFacade[owner]. Retry registration for every unregistered owner at RegisterOwner, on ADDON_LOADED('EllesmereUI') and at PLAYER_LOGIN, through lib.SafeRegisterEvent (not a raw RegisterEvent). GetEUIStatus gains a fourth condition, 'EllesmereUI handed us its skin this session', with the hint 'Reload the UI'. The EUI choice is selectable only when all four conditions hold. (3) One function, EnterEUI(owner), handles both the live switch and the late arrival of the facade. It hides the owner's Ka0s holders, runs the EUI primitive per record, then re-runs the Ka0s extras in eui mode. Once it has run, lib.euiPainted[owner] latches for the session, and any later gate failure or source change sets pending-reload and never falls back live. The live Ka0s fallback applies only when EUI has not painted this session. (4) The eui provider strips Ka0s-only option keys (primary, role, ...) before calling an EUI primitive. (5) Pooled or shared objects (AceGUI widgets and pull-outs, the Widgets.lua popup menu, the WidgetsReorder ghost, any lib-level singleton) are NEVER passed to an EllesmereUI primitive. Under eui they keep the Ka0s overlay technique, with colors and font from the stored facade's GetAccentColor/GetPanelColor/GetFont. Tests: registration before the EllesmereUI global exists followed by a retry; a second minor still receives the facade; gate open with no facade leaves the choice disabled; an eui-owned AceGUI CheckBox makes zero calls to the fake EUI. Follow the LK-01 versioning ruling; add the complexity-suite VERIFY line.

items.issue_refs: 03_SPEC §3 Unowned callers; inputs/LIBKA0S_INTERNALS.md; inputs/ACEGUI_AND_ENGINE_RESEARCH.md (§2 constants table, §3 owner availability)
items.spec:
Make each factory accept an optional owner (a descriptor field or a trailing argument; additive, no signature break) and, when given, paint via Skin:For(owner) primitives and register the frame for repaint; without an owner keep today's exact output (pin it). lib.SKIN and the published tables stay exported unchanged. Core must not hard-require the Skin major at load (Skin floors on Core; Core resolves Skin at call time, as MakeCloseButton resolves Media). Minor bumps per file; api docs updated per convention (members manifests). Tests: owner-less output unchanged (golden-ish pins); with an owner, colors come from that owner's skin; two owners side by side stay isolated; the popup menu follows the opener.

PLAN-REVIEW RESOLUTION: a name counts as an owner only if Skin:IsOwner(name) is true. Every consumer already passes addonName (Core.lua:239-247 MakeCloseButton; LootHistory core/CoreSetup.lua:277), and after LootHistory's copy wins, the 13 unconverted addons run this code too. Shared singletons (the Widgets.lua:223 popup menu, the WidgetsReorder.lua:97 ghost) are repainted on EVERY open: to the opener's skin when the opener is registered, otherwise actively back to Ka0s Default. Tests: an unregistered addonName produces a recorder trace identical to the owner-less call; a LootHistory-owned open under Obsidian, followed by an owner-less open, shows Ka0s Default. items.spec:

Route every hard-coded chrome constant in Options.lua (header + divider), OptionsTabs.lua (TAB_BG_*, CHROME_RULE_COLOR, Blizzard tab atlases: fade + Ka0s tab art for non-default skins), OptionsNav.lua (PANE_*, SELECT_RGB, LABEL_GOLD), OptionsDrawer.lua (HEAD_*, BOX_*, SUMMARY_*), OptionsCombat.lua (cover), OptionsIds/OptionsIdList (suggest popup, help tints), OptionsKeybinds (rows), OptionsScroll (THUMB_ON/OFF) through the owner's skin with repaint registration. Several of these files are in the 1000-1500 band with triggers (CLAUDE.md register): keep each edit to a thin S.<prim>(...) call; where a trigger fires, peel on the named seam in this item and update the census rows. OptionsCompose font/statusbar/border pickers: add a "From skin" entry (value Skin.FROM_SKIN) whose preview shows the owner's resolved value; composer defaults unchanged in leg 1 (addons opt in at leg 2). Minors, api docs, CLAUDE.md census rows. Tests: owner-less pages unchanged; owned pages paint from the skin and repaint on SetChoice; From-skin entry resolves.

PLAN-REVIEW RESOLUTION: (1) Replace the 'From skin' picker entry. The LSM30_* widgets show the list KEY as the label and use the list value as the media path (OptionsCompose.lua:553-556/:599-600/:628-629; Options.lua:1239-1251 O.LSMValues maps k->k and feeds the CLI's allowed values), so a sentinel there breaks both the preview and the CLI. Instead, the FontGroup/BorderGroup/BarGroup composers gain an opt-in `fromSkin = true` that emits a companion bool row <key>FromSkin ('Use the skin's font/texture/border', default false in leg 1). While it is true, the LSM30 picker is disabled, it shows S.Resolve's value as read-only text, and S.Resolve returns the skin's value. No sentinel string ever enters an LSM list or the CLI values. R3's 'reset to From skin' becomes setting the companions to true. Tests: no fromSkin gives exactly today's rows; with fromSkin, the companion writes and clears, the picker is disabled while it is set, and the CLI allowed values are unchanged. Put these in a NEW suite, because tests/test_options_compose.lua (1012) peels on 'the next OptionsCompose minor that adds cases here'. (2) Only Skin:IsOwner(d.addonName) pages are owned. Unregistered pages are byte-for-byte today's. (3) An owned page whose skin is not ka0s gets an opaque page backdrop (S.Panel on the canvas from win.bg at full alpha, since Options.lua:658 creates a bare Frame), so light skins such as Azeroth stay legible over Blizzard's SettingsPanel. Owner-less and Ka0s Default pages are unchanged. (4) Band triggers: OptionsTabs (1350, 'next member added') and Options.lua (1320, 'next member added') take only thin S.<prim> calls and no new members. If a trigger fires, peel on the named seam in this item and update the census and the register row. Follow the LK-01 versioning ruling; add the complexity-suite VERIFY line.

items.title: AceGUI rows skinned per owner with restore-on-release (SkinAce): CheckBox, Slider, Dropdown + pull-out, EditBox, MultiLineEditBox, Button, Heading, Label, InteractiveLabel, Icon, ColorPicker swatch, InlineGroup, ScrollFrame
items.spec:
Implement LibKa0s/SkinAce.lua (secondary on the Skin shell). OptionsWidgets (and the other makers that acquire AceGUI widgets) call Skin:PaintAce(owner, widget) right after acquiring when the page has an owner and that owner's skin is not ka0s (Ka0s Default = stock AceGUI as today, nothing painted). Fade stock regions by alpha and record prior alpha/font/colors/backdrop in the weak table; create overlays once per widget object (reuse on re-acquire); chain the widget's per-instance OnRelease (as OptionsScroll.lua does) to restore every recorded value and hide overlays; Dropdown pull-out painted on open for its owner, restored on close; guard every field (AceGUI version drift); step aside if ElvUI/AddOnSkins skinned the widget (detect their markers) . LSM30 pull-outs and ColorPickerFrame stay stock. Tests (headless AceGUI mocks; add what is missing to the LK-01 recorder via a further kit tweak only if needed, bumping the kit revision again only if testkit changes): owner A paints a CheckBox, releases it, owner B (or a non-Ka0s addon) acquires the same object and sees stock values; repaint on SetChoice; Ka0s Default paints nothing.

PLAN-REVIEW RESOLUTION: (1) Paint at one choke point. SkinAce's guarded attach, lib.__AttachSkinAce(O, d), wraps the instance's O.AceGUI (Options.lua:520, OptionsRegistry.lua:199) in a proxy whose Create(type) calls the real Create and then Skin:PaintAce(d.addonName, w) when Skin:IsOwner holds. Route any site that uses a raw LibStub AceGUI local (Options.lua ~:307/:775/:859, OptionsKeybinds.lua ~:756) through O.AceGUI. This keeps OptionsWidgets.lua (1444 lines, trigger '1450 or the next maker added') from growing. Re-measure the band files afterwards and record the figures in the CLAUDE.md band prose and the automated-tests-§4 row. If OptionsWidgets still reaches 1450, peel flowRows and the switched sections in this item (majors.lua, XML, key, in-flight doc, census). (2) Publish Skin:PaintAce(owner, widget) and Skin:PaintAceTree(owner, container) as public, documented members for host-acquired widgets, plus Skin:OnRelease(widget, fn), a chain helper, so a host OnRelease and the skin restore coexist (options-ui-§19: AceGUI keeps one callback per name). (3) Durability: once per widget object, hooksecurefunc(widget, 'SetDisabled', post), HookScript on the Slider editbox OnEnter/OnLeave, and a hook on Label SetFontObject. Each post-hook re-applies the owner's tokens only while the widget is owned per the weak state table, and otherwise does nothing. (4) The OnRelease wrapper first sets self.OnRelease = original, then pcalls its own restore (logging once on failure), then always calls the original, because AceGUI:Release calls OnRelease raw (AceGUI-3.0.lua:172-182). (5) Do not repaint AceGUI rows in place. On S.OnLooksChanged, Options re-renders the owner's open panels one frame later (C_Timer.After(0)): release restores stock, and re-acquire paints the new skin, or nothing under ka0s. (6) Pooled widgets are never passed to EllesmereUI primitives (see LK-05). (7) Under Ka0s Default nothing is painted. Tests: paint, SetDisabled(true), then SetDisabled(false) keeps the skin color; a raising restore still returns the widget to the pool; a host OnRelease plus PaintAce, release, re-acquire gives stock; ka0s->obsidian with a page open repaints after the deferred re-render; an eui owner makes zero fake-EUI calls. Follow the LK-01 versioning ruling; add the complexity-suite VERIFY line.

(2) The tab writes only through the owner's spec.set, documented as 'MUST be the owner's write seam'. Copy-to-all writes through each target owner's registered opts.set. Select calls Skin:SetChoice(owner, ...) first, then set(). SetChoice is idempotent (LK-03), so the owner's onChange calling SetChoice again is a no-op, and the reload popup is raised once, by the tab, from SetChoice's pending-reload return. (3) The button label is 'Copy to every Ka0s addon…' (U+2026, options-ui-§21). With no other registered owner it is disabled with the hint 'No other loaded Ka0s addon uses skins yet.' Follow the LK-01 versioning ruling; add the complexity-suite VERIFY line.

items.title: Skin seam: register owner "LootHistory", appearance profile keys, Appearance tab on General (after Interface), live-repaint plumbing (SETTINGS_CHANGED skin, AdoptProfile)
items.spec:
New seam file (e.g. core/SkinSetup.lua; Browser.lua 1327 and BrowserTable.lua 1320 are near the cap) with a TOC row in the right load position, a docs/module-map.md row and a degraded arm pinned by test_surface_parity: NS.Skin = Skin:For("LootHistory") with RegisterOwner get/set over the profile's appearance table. defaults: appearance = { source = "ka0s", skin = "ka0s" } (AceDB default-merge; no migration). Appearance tab via O.AppearanceTab in GENERAL_TABS (settings/Panel.lua ~:986) after Interface, Keybindings stays last; schema rows as the repo's schema conventions require (test_schema two-controls rule satisfied). Live repaint: the set path fires SETTINGS_CHANGED "skin" -> B:OnSettingsChanged -> tab registry; B:AdoptProfile re-applies. Locales for any new strings. Docs: schema.md, settings-panel.md. Tests for keys, tab placement, repaint dispatch.

PLAN-REVIEW RESOLUTION: (1) Storage: declare two schema rows under the repo's convention (defaults/Profile.lua keeps settings under `settings = {...}`): settings.appearance.source (choice ka0s|eui, default 'ka0s') and settings.appearance.skin (choice over the registered skin keys, default 'ka0s'). Use page General, group 'Appearance', declared contiguously after the History block with skipRender = true, because the tab draws them. Defaults are AceDB-merged, with no migration. (2) The seam is core/SkinSetup.lua (fixed name; LibKa0s's Consumers row cites it), loaded after core/CoreSetup.lua and before core/WidgetsSetup.lua. Live arm: NS.Skin = Skin:For('LootHistory'). RegisterOwner opts.get reads the rows via Schema:Get, lazily and nil-safely (it answers ka0s before InitDB). opts.set writes through Schema:Set, the same seam `/lh set` uses. The rows' onChange calls Skin:SetChoice, which is idempotent. Degraded arm: a table that answers every facade name. Token/Color/Text return Ka0s Default values from a host copy limited to the tokens LootHistory reads, Shell/TitleBar route to the existing CoreSetup fallback (NS.ApplySkin), and every other primitive is a no-op that never raises. Add a four-argument parity case (live NS.Skin vs degradedNS.Skin), a case asserting each host-copy token equals the live library's ka0s value, and a degraded-load case proving the file-load markup (BrowserTable.lua:326-327, HoldingsTab.lua:304-305, Panel.lua:600-603) builds. (3) Repaint: every skin-dependent rebuild (window, tabs, filter bar, row menu, tab-registry reskin, file-load markup) subscribes to NS.Skin.OnLooksChanged, which fires after resolving. Nothing skin-related keys off SETTINGS_CHANGED. Call Skin:SetChoice('LootHistory', ...) once right after AceDB is created in OnInitialize, and FIRST in NS.OnProfileEvent (core/LootHistory.lua:95-106), before NS.Browser:AdoptProfile, whether or not the window exists (B:AdoptProfile returns early at Browser.lua:823-824 when the window was never built). (4) Tab: build `local at = O.AppearanceTab({ owner='LootHistory', get=..., set=... })` and insert {key=at.key, label=at.label, tooltip=at.tooltip, build=at.render} into GENERAL_TABS after History and before the Keybindings append (Panel.lua:997-1006). The order becomes ... Interface, History, Appearance, Keybindings, which is 8 tabs, the options-ui-§13 budget. (5) Append EllesmereUI to LootHistory.toc:8 ## OptionalDeps (library-stack-§6(b); PGFE toc:9 precedent), pin it if a TOC test reads OptionalDeps, and update docs/module-map.md's OptionalDeps sentence and its LibKa0s major count. (6) In the same commit, update tests/test_schema.lua PARTITION :659-665 (+{'Appearance',2} placed to match the tab order), STORED_SETTINGS :1229-1263, panel_support.lua STRIP :112-118, test_panel.lua SUBGROUPS :357-369 (the headings O.AppearanceTab draws), the row-count claims in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/settings-panel.md and both docs/module-map.md sentences, both module-map per-tab breakdowns (keep the 'Master controls %d+.-History %d+' regex :837-870 matching, so list Appearance after History), the authored-file count (59 -> 60), schema.md, tests/run.lua and the docs/testing.md suite table.
